messages:
Marta: Canary note: a handful of nodes kept serving epoch=7 after we activated epoch=9. Thinking: add transition_epoch + grace_ms + dry_run to rollout metadata so hosts can log "pin_would_evict" before we enforce. Thoughts?

Diego: here's the log: `node-3 restore pin model=alpha epoch=7; rollout.activate(epoch=9) @+8s; served epoch=7 @+12s`

Lin: Yea resolver race. transition_epoch + dry_run looks right. Also add eviction_policy enum and per-host debounce_ms so we don't oscillate.

Marta: Draft metadata example I want in RFC: {"rollout_id":"r-2026-04","target":"alpha@9","transition_epoch":9,"grace_ms":15000,"dry_run":true,"eviction_policy":"soft","debounce_ms":30000,"origin":"ci/canary","compat":"v2"}

Ops-Bot: Pipeline created: rollout-schema/dry-run (pr-9001)

Diego: Migration plan: (1) ship runtime that emits metrics pin_would_evict and pin_seen_epoch; (2) run a dry_run rollout for 48h and collect telemetry; (3) enable enforcement after sanity checks.

Lin: Add alert if >0.5% of hosts report pin_seen_epoch < transition_epoch after 10m. Also require rollout_token signature on metadata for provenance.

Marta: I'll update the RFC with fields, examples, and the staged dry_run plan. Scheduling dry_run next Tue.
notes: action items: Marta update RFC + schedule dry_run; Diego add alert rule and telemetry queries; Lin add debounce logic and eviction_policy enum; Ops run pr-9001 and collect 48h telemetry; Security ensure rollout_token signing.
